'''Blackguard's Gorge''' was a location on [[Orsis]] and beyond a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range from the [[Orsis Academy]]. It was reputed to be the former residence of a [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]. The fortress in this gorge soon became the private retreat of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] during [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul's]] [[Time/Legends|time]] at the Orsis Academy, and Maul was permitted to go there via [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], to continue his training in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Neither [[Trezza]] nor Maul knew how Sidious had procured this residence.<ref name="The Wrath of Darth Maul" />
